datasheet_identity.title: SS52BF THRU SS520BF SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Family datasheet SS52BF THRU SS520BF; SS54BF is the 40 V member (VRRM = VDC = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, p. 1 Maximum Ratings).
Table column groupings verified on p. 2: VF max 0.55 V covers SS52BF-SS545BF; IR1 0.5 mA (25 degC) and IR2 50 mA (100 degC) cover SS52BF-SS58BF; CJ 800 pF covers SS52BF-SS545BF.
The 100 degC reverse-current row (IR2 = 50 mA max at VR = VDC) and the Fig. 4 Tj = 100 degC traces were not extracted; only 25 degC data is recorded.
Fig. 4 x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage and is preserved as published; multiply by 0.4 V per percent for SS54BF to obtain volts.
No reverse recovery time and no measured breakdown row are published; the 40 V VRRM rating is a maximum rating, not a breakdown measurement, so breakdown fields are null.
Figs. 1-2 (current derating versus lead temperature and surge current versus cycles) are ratings curves and were not extracted.
Curve y-values were converted from the printed mA axes to SI amperes.
